dogecoin.text:
For a while, $PENGU was the vibe.
Cool memes. Clean branding.
Everyone was shouting: "PENGU UP!" and dropping penguin GIFs like it was the next $DOGE

Real Life Stories

• @dogecoin : TikTok stunts and celebrity tweets led to wild price jumps, most short lived.

• @ShibainuCoin : Memes turned some into overnight millionaires, and left others in the red.

Even $BTC has seen its biggest moves after a wave of posts goes viral. https://t.co/3d0ZIxkbVH

FOMO: The Emotional Rollercoaster

• Ever see a coin suddenly trending and feel you’ll miss out if you don’t jump in? That's FOMO: fear of missing out.

• A single viral post can cause a rush to buy, making prices surge in hours.

For example: Dogecoin went wild after TikToks https://t.co/ZPGilWGoxP
